original_content_full:
The paper "Non-Photorealistic Rendering of 3D Point Clouds Using Segment-Specific Image-Space Effects" got accepted at the 19th International Conference on Computer Graphics Theory and Applications (GRAPP 2024).
It was authored by Ole Wegen, Josafat-Mattias Burmeister, Max Reimann, Rico Richter, and Jürgen Döllner.

The GRAPP conference is part of VISIGRAPP, the 19th International Joint Conference on Computer Vision, Imaging and Computer Graphics Theory and Applications.
It will be held in Rome, Italy from February 27 to 29. Visit their website for details.
